author.heading: About David Foster Wallace
author.bio: David Foster Wallace (1962–2008) was an American novelist and essayist raised in Illinois. He studied philosophy and English at Amherst, taught creative writing, and published Infinite Jest in 1996; his essays and fiction often explore attention, entertainment and the difficulty of connecting with others.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Infinite Jest juxtaposes a tennis academy with a substance-recovery halfway house. The sentence belongs to a long list of observations about living with other people, attention, pain and recovery. Its point is the distinction between being physically alone and feeling lonely, expressed inside the novel’s narrative rather than as a clinical definition.
